properties.name: Re-attaching #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] to set_interface_spec, which lost it when set_capability_signature was inserted between the attribute and the function. The allow silently transferred to the new 5-argument function and clippy flagged the old 11-argument one. No design meaning: the same code, with the lint suppression back on the function it was written for.
